_comment: Live config. Both Gemini Pro-tier options are dead ends: gemini-3.1-pro-preview hit a hard 429 quota-exceeded (needs billing enabled, not just a low free allowance) and gemini-2.5-pro came back 404 'no longer available to new users' - a real decommission, not a rate issue. unify/character/atmosphere run on gemini-3.6-flash (proven live repeatedly); editor runs on gemini-3.5-flash-lite - a distinct GA model from unify's 3.6-flash, so it isn't literally grading its own output. action moved to gemini-3.6-flash too after the ch. 2 overnight cron run hit the exact same Groq TPM wall character did (openai/gpt-oss-20b, 8000 limit, 14081 requested) - action carries the motif-ledger brief same as character/atmosphere, and that ledger only grows chapter over chapter, so this was always going to recur once canon.md and the ledger grew past whatever headroom chapter 1 had. Only skeleton and summariser stay on Groq now: skeleton's input never includes the motif section and has held up across every chapter so far; summariser doesn't send canon.md at all, so its input is small regardless of how much else grows. Mistral is parked entirely: 429 rate_limited on the very first call, two different roles, two separate runs, before Groq's own error confirmed canon.md's size is the real constraint - worth checking its dashboard limits directly before trying again.
